hero.eyebrow: Point of sale, built for retail
hero.title: Every sale, Captured.
hero.lead: Popy runs your checkout, tracks your stock across every branch, and closes your books — reliably, down to every transaction.

features.title: Everything a checkout counter needs to run itself.
features.lead: Four systems working from one shared ledger — so stock, sales, and reporting never drift out of sync.

inventory.title: Live inventory sync
inventory.body: Stock updates the instant a sale rings up — across every register and every branch.

branches.title: Multi-branch by default
branches.body: Run one shop or twenty from a single dashboard, with per-location pricing and stock.

reporting.title: Real-time reporting
reporting.body: Know today's revenue, margin, and top sellers before you close the till.

payments.title: Secure payments
payments.body: Card, cash, and QR — reconciled automatically, with every transaction logged.

how.title: Live in three steps.
how.lead: No IT team required — most shops are ringing up sales the same day.

step1.title: Set up your catalog
step1.body: Import your products, prices, and stock — by spreadsheet or barcode scan.

step2.title: Start selling
step2.body: Ring up sales from any till or device, online or offline.

step3.title: Track every branch
step3.body: Watch sales, stock, and margin roll up in one live dashboard.

testimonials.title: What shop owners say after switching.

one.quote: Stock across our two branches finally matches. We stopped over-ordering within the first month.

two.quote: Reporting used to take a spreadsheet and an hour. Now it's already there when I open the shop.

three.quote: Support actually picks up. That alone was worth the switch from our old system.

four.quote: Cashiers picked it up in an afternoon. We didn't need a trainer.

five.quote: We finally see which branch is actually making money, day by day.

six.quote: Offline mode saved us during a power cut. Sales still went through.

pricing.title: Straightforward plans, no surprise fees.
pricing.lead: Every plan includes unlimited transactions and free support.

starter.name: Starter
starter.desc: For a single till, single location.

cta.title: Trusted at every transaction.
cta.lead: Set up your first branch today — most shops are live and selling by the end of the day.

footer.tagline: Point-of-sale software for retail shops that run on trust — one till or a hundred.
